description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Set up your Cymetica company: a Manager agent that runs departments staffed with expert agents. Omit departments to start from the templates (Development, Testing, Testing lab, Trading desk). One company per account; paper by default. REST twin: POST /api/v1/company.

departments.description: Optional list of {key, name, charter, experts:[expert keys]}; omit to use the templates

mission.description: What the company is for, in a sentence or two

report_style.description: How the Manager reports to you, e.g. 'daily summary'

name: company_create
title: Company Create
